newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers rise as majors face supply problems.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers rise as majors face supply problems.

text.p: ARA bunker prices rose on Friday as a number of majors faced supply problems, while Mediterranean prices were flat, dealers said.

Rotterdam 380 cst was rated at $123/$124 fob towards the close, $1/$2 a tonne higher than on Thursday. Demand was reasonable, but bunkering was largely prevented by supply problems at three majors, dealers said.
"We could only manage about 2,000-3,000 tonnes (of deliveries) today," one bunker supplier said.
Two majors were running low of product, while another suffered from off-spec material in its tanks.
Hamburg also rose by $1/$2, maintaining the premium over Rotterdam.
Mediterranean prices, however, were flat and buying was very poor in almost all ports.
Fujairah bunkers rose to $119 fob, just short of year highs on supply shortages, said dealers, describing overall demand as fair.
